methodology_note: Market size figures for 'AI in restaurants' vary significantly ($6.9B–$82.7B by 2034) depending on market definition: narrow (kitchen robotics only), mid (QSR AI + robotics), and broad (all AI applied to food service, including marketing AI, scheduling AI, loyalty AI, and delivery AI). This report uses the broad definition ($13.2B in 2025) for market size and the narrow definition (restaurant robotics $1.8B in 2026, +61% YoY) for the most recent high-momentum data point. Growth_5y (+230%) calculated: $4B approximate 2021 AI-in-restaurants market → $13.2B in 2025 = 3.3x = +230%. Growth_1y (+61%) uses the restaurant robotics segment YoY to reflect the hottest momentum signal. Growth_3m (+21%) derived from agentic AI restaurant automation segment quarterly growth implied by annual CAGR of 21%.
